Harbor still has the queen studio, coffee maker, mini-fridge, fitness room, and parking confirmed. Caveat: no pool at all during your stay, and it already had no hot tub. With the earlier Monday start, I would keep Harbor unless the pool is make-or-break.
That's what I needed. I don't want to chase amenities and make both mornings harder.

Then keep Harbor. The clinic wants you at the staff rehab entrance by 7:30 Monday to unlock the gym and drop the rolling demo bag. Leave the hotel at 7:00. Tuesday can be 7:15 if the bag stays locked there overnight; make it 7:05 only if you end up carrying it back.

Good. I also need an easy food plan after landing, nothing elaborate.

Simple version: after rental pickup, stop at the Harris Teeter on the way to Cary for water, yogurt or snacks, and coffee creamer; it adds about 8 minutes. If the flight or car counter runs late, skip it and use the hotel market since the room fridge and coffee maker are confirmed.
Okay, keep Harbor. Please note the closure clearly so I don't pack like there is a pool.

Arrival plan is rental car, quick Harris Teeter stop if timing is easy, then check in.

messages.content: I got a late ask from Nashville Children's Rehab. They want me for a pediatric gait seminar in early December. Can you scope the travel before I say yes?
Yes. Give me the teaching dates and anything schedule-sensitive, especially setup and teardown.
Teach Friday Dec 11 and Saturday Dec 12. They want me there Thursday for a room layout check. Saturday teardown may run close to 5:00. I'm coming from Tampa.
Got it. I’ll look at this around protecting the Thursday room check and not making Saturday night a race. Are you open to returning Sunday if Saturday evening is too tight?
Yes. Please group the options by what is actually practical, not just cheapest.

Most practical: Thursday nonstop TPA to BNA about 2:05-2:55 p.m. Central, then Sunday return around 1:35-4:15 p.m., currently about $426. It protects the room check and keeps Sunday reasonable. Cheaper but brittle: Thursday connection through Atlanta arriving about 8:55 p.m., Sunday similar return, about $318; that likely misses any useful layout time. Fastest home: Thursday nonstop plus Saturday evening return around 6:40 p.m. with a connection, about $390; only works if teardown ends early and traffic to BNA behaves.
Saturday evening sounds like asking for trouble. What about hotels?

Two real contenders. The hospital-rate hotel is closest: $169/night, roughly a 5-minute walk or shuttle, public rating around 4.1. But it lists run-of-house bedding, cannot confirm a refrigerator, and says coffee maker by request. Fitness room is listed; no useful pool setup. West End Suites is farther, usually 12-18 minutes by car, $206/night, public rating around 4.5. It confirms a queen studio, coffee maker, mini-fridge, fitness room, and indoor pool. Caveats: no hot tub and parking is $28/night.
The hospital one being closest is tempting, but run-of-house before teaching is not my favorite.

That is the main trade-off. Hospital hotel wins price and location. West End wins predictability and recent reviews, but costs roughly $111 more over three nights once parking is included, and you would have a short ride each teaching day.
Do I need a car in Nashville for this, or could rideshare work?

Rideshare looks cleaner unless they make you move gear every day. Airport to West End, two morning rides to the center, Saturday back to the hotel, and Sunday to BNA should be about $120-$150 total. Hotel parking alone would be $84 before rental cost.
I should only have one rolling demo bag plus my suitcase, not a trunk full.
Then rideshare should handle it if the host can store the demo bag. I would not add a rental unless they cannot offer locked storage.
Can you list what we still need from the host? I don't want to book blind.

Send them these: Thursday access window for room layout, exact entrance and badge process, whether someone can meet you with a cart, locked overnight storage for the demo bag, Saturday teardown deadline and building close time, rideshare drop-off point, and whether their mats or steps are available or if anything needs shipping.
Include AV too. Last center had the HDMI adapter drama.
Added: projector or large display, HDMI and USB-C adapter availability, extension cords, speaker if video audio is needed, and who owns the room reset after Saturday.
If they can give me until 6:30 or 7 Thursday, the nonstop seems fine. If access ends at 5, I may need to fly earlier.

Right. The Thursday nonstop lands around 2:55 p.m. Central. With deplaning and rideshare, you could likely reach the center around 4:00-4:20 if you go straight there, or closer to 5:00 if you drop your suitcase at West End first. It only works cleanly if they keep the room open past about 5:30.
For now, lean West End and the Sunday return. Don't book until they answer access and storage.

Noted. Working Nashville plan: Thursday afternoon nonstop from Tampa, Sunday afternoon return, rideshare instead of rental unless gear needs change, and West End Suites as the lead hotel because the room setup is clear. Open caveats before committing: no hot tub, paid parking if you rent a car, and the hospital-rate hotel remains cheaper and closer but has unconfirmed bedding and fridge. I drafted the host questions covering access, storage, teardown, AV, and rideshare drop-off.

Windows are available: 12A outbound and 10F on the return. Want me to finalize flights first, then the hotel?
Yes. And no rental car for now, right?
Correct. Rideshare still looks simpler and cheaper since the host will store the demo bag. I will leave the rental car off.

Before I click it: queen studio, coffee maker, mini-fridge, indoor pool, fitness room; no hot tub; $206/night before taxes; free cancellation until Dec 8 at 6:00 p.m.; parking $28/night only if used. Still okay?
Yes, those trade-offs are fine.
Hotel booked: West End Suites Nashville, confirmation WEN-38472, Thu Dec 10-Sun Dec 13, queen studio. I added a quiet-room request away from elevators.

If baggage or rideshare is slow, go straight from BNA to the center and check in afterward. Saturday demo bag stays locked in the rehab office until teardown ends.
